RIGHT panel labeled in a slim external top strip “空堆 · 开演”: tower counter now 0 (only change that small number). The same gold thread bundles have pulled farther apart toward the outer flanks, leaving a broad CLEAR gap behind Karen. A soft warm ivory followspot from above right is now aimed at Karen's upper body, ending ABOVE her feet, with a few small stars rising outwards. Visibly OPEN and brighter than waiting yet soft enough for actual gameplay. No energy rays in these idle states.
Keep exact original camera/framing and gameplay art. Use slender luminous thread cores, no opaque panel or frame, no geometric outline gate. Maintain character and enemy clarity; gold threads stay behind character. All embellishment confined to Karen's side of battlefield; enemy untouched.
